title: D CORE LC-LC OM3 1M Multimode Duplex Fiber Patch Cable

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your high-speed network infrastructure with the D CORE LC-LC OM3 Duplex Multimode Fiber Patch Cable. Designed for efficiency and reliability, this 1-meter (3.28ft) cable features LC duplex connectors on both ends, ensuring seamless connectivity for 10Gb/s applications in data centers, server rooms, and enterprise networks. The distinctive aqua jacket confirms OM3 compatibility, while the precision-engineered connectors deliver low insertion loss for optimal signal integrity.


Key Features:

  • High Performance: Supports 10Gb/s data transfer over multimode fiber (OM3), perfect for high-bandwidth needs.
  • Durable Design: Flexible, riser-rated jacket with sturdy LC connectors and boot protection for longevity.
  • Easy Identification: Aqua color-coding for quick OM3 recognition and efficient cable management.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly with switches, routers, servers, and storage equipment.
  • Reliable Low Loss: Precision-polished connectors minimize signal loss (<0.3dB) for consistent performance.
  • Ideal For: Data centers, server farms, network upgrades, SAN/NAS setups, and telecom installations.


Specifications:

  • Connector: LC-LC Duplex
  • Cable Type: OM3 Multimode (50/125µm)
  • Length: 1 Meters (3.28ft)
  • Jacket Color: Aqua
  • Insertion Loss: ≤0.3dB
